messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Greene <sophie.greene@aureliatech.com>, Ian Matthews <ian.matthews@aureliatech.com>
Cc: rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-10T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: MAP: Security review + SOC 2 package delivery (Aurelia Tech)

Hi Sophie / Ian,

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery and the next steps we agreed on. I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the security review milestone and SOC 2 package delivery. High-level items below: 

MAP Milestone: Security review + SOC 2 package delivery
- Target milestone date: 2026-11-20 (security review completed)
- Target deal close: 2026-12-08 (tentative, dependent on security signoff)
- Redwood deliverables (by 2026-11-15): SOC 2 questionnaire answers, SOC 2 evidence bundle (redacted where required), system architecture diagram, and requested logs list.
- Aurelia deliverables: Provide list of specific evidence fields you need filled and confirm whether you require in-place access or redacted artifacts.
- Dependencies: NDA signed (we have copy on file), SSO test account for validation (Aurelia to provide), scope confirmation for data residency.

Attachments in the draft MAP:
- 20261115-Redwood-MAP-draft-AureliaTech.pdf (MAP with milestones/responsibilities)
- 20261115-SOC2-questionnaire-aurelia.xlsx (SOC 2 questionnaire template — fillable)
- 20261115-Redwood-SOC2-package.zip (evidence index + redacted artifacts)

Ask: Please confirm which artifacts you need verbatim (e.g., full logs vs sampling) and whether your security team prefers a live walkthrough or written delivery. If live, we can schedule a 30-60m session the week of 11/16.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm required artifacts and preferred delivery method — by 2026-11-12
2) Redwood provides the SOC 2 package and completed questionnaire — by 2026-11-15
3) Aurelia performs security review and lists any follow-ups — by 2026-11-20

Looking forward to closing the MAP items. I copied Rachel (SE) to coordinate the architecture diagram and Aditya (Infosec) to own the evidence bundle.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Date: 2026-11-11T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Security review + SOC 2 package delivery (Aurelia Tech)

Thanks Marissa, appreciate the clear MAP. A few clarifying items from our security team: 

1) Evidence specifics: we will need a sample of the following as part of the SOC 2 package:
   - Control logs (redacted) showing access control events for the last 90 days
   - Configuration snapshots for production (IAM roles, KMS policies)
   - Incident response runbook excerpt and most recent tabletop exercise notes
   - SSAE/SOC 2 attestation report summary (if available)

2) Architecture diagram: we prefer a diagram that includes data flow into/out of Redwood, where PII may be stored or cached, and what controls are applied at each boundary.

3) Delivery method: written delivery is fine for the initial review; we will request a live walkthrough if any answers require follow-up.

Can you confirm whether you can provide the logs as redacted CSVs and an exported config snapshot? If so, the initial review team will plan to complete by 11/20.

Sophie
Head of Security Programs | Aurelia Tech
sophie.greene@aureliatech.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, rachel_kim@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai

Team — forwarding Sophie's note. Summary and action items:

Action owner: Aditya Rao (infosec)
- Task: Assemble SOC 2 evidence bundle (redacted logs, config snapshots, IR runbook excerpt, attestation summary)
- Deliverable: 20261115-Redwood-SOC2-package.zip (index + artifacts)
- Due: 2026-11-15 EOD

Action owner: Rachel Kim (SE)
- Task: Update system architecture diagram to include data flow and controls; export a PDF version and a Visio/PNG.
- Deliverable: redwood-system-architecture-v1.pdf
- Due: 2026-11-14 EOD (so we have time to review before delivery)

Action owner: Vivek Kulkarni (legal)
- Task: Quick check on redaction guidance and confirm we can share requested artifacts under existing NDA.
- Due: 2026-11-13 EOD

Notes: Sophie confirmed written delivery is fine for initial review; they will request a live walkthrough only if needed. Sophie specifically asked for redacted CSV logs (last 90 days) and config snapshots.

Aditya / Rachel / Vivek — please reply with ETA if any of the due dates look risky. I'll own the customer comms and final delivery.

Thanks,
Marissa
